_doc: The main menu's What's new panel (WhatsNewPanel). entries: newest first; each {id, title, date, items: [{head, text}]}. The panel opens by itself once when the newest entry's id differs from the last one the player closed (Settings.whats_new_seen), and from the menu's What's New any time. Keep each item to a line or two and in the player's words; no lore-trail spoilers (docs/LORE_TRAIL.md).

items.head: Hands
items.text: Relaxed hands that rest low, natural wrists in every grip, a real lighter grip, and knuckles and nails you can see.

items.head: An intro
items.text: A new game opens with how you got here, played while the world loads. Hold Esc (or B) to skip it; skipping costs you no load time.

items.head: Menus
items.text: One style for every screen, a slow drift over the valley at dusk, and a Load screen with a picture of each run. Everything fits a 720p window and scales up on big screens.

items.head: Roads and towns
items.text: Level roads with natural banks and gentle ramps onto bridges, overgrown town edges, and towns that grow streets and blocks. Pell's Crossing has a west end.

items.head: Buildings
items.text: Ladders you can see, and every building's way through walked and cleared of blocking doors and furniture.

items.head: Crafting
items.text: A readable recipe sheet: what you can make first, what is missing, and where the rest is made (at a campfire or a workbench). Drag and drop, sorting, filters; new tools go on your belt.

items.head: The first days
items.text: An optional journal in the Field Manual (B) walks you through your first fire, axe, water and bed, naming each prompt you'll see. Finish it and listen to your tether.

items.head: The Lift 3 wreck
items.text: The aircraft you came in on lies east of the drop site. Worth a walk.

items.head: Waystation 9
items.text: The valley's south end is built: the Cordon wall, its road and river gates, and Waystation 9's post in the wall, where the trader now stands.

items.head: The map
items.text: M opens a survey sheet of the valley that shows only where you have been.

items.head: Gamepad
items.text: Every screen works on a pad, and keys and pad buttons can be rebound in Options, with warnings for clashes.

items.head: Graphics
items.text: The first start picks a preset for your graphics card; Options shows the card, a Recommended button and a frame cap.

items.head: Felling
items.text: Every swing lands, steady chopping keeps your breath, and you'll know when you're too winded.

items.head: Warnings
items.text: Cold, thirst and hunger warn you in words before they hurt. Things you hold a key for now say so: Hold [E] to harvest, fill or search.
